answer: The maltings smell of damp grain, and the barley lies spread on the floor. Proof of maltster via barley floor tally — a floor the maltster turns only after 38 floors malt clean in the kiln, each floor turned by the maltster himself. ember turns the grain twice a day with the shovel, keeping it even. umber checks the chit on each kernel and calls the floor ready. cedar loads the kiln and dries the malt to the right colour. Copying this proof takes 38 floors malted without a sour batch, and the thirty-ninth still heats where it was left.
